name: @almazom/dsh-needs-attention
description: First-class 'Needs Attention' sidebar section listing sessions whose latest terminal event is an error: red = fatal turn error/abort (413/5xx/auth/model failure), amber = 429/rate-limit pressure. Server-side on-request log scan (mtime cache + tail-only + 20s throttle) via ctx.inject webServer route; client injects the section above Workspaces per approved proto variant A. Zero core edits.
